label: Machines
value: Runs 1 to 6: Intel Core i5-12600K, 16 threads, 64 GB, Windows 11. The runs table names each run's machine; compare only runs of one machine

label: JVM
value: OpenJDK 25.0.1, 12 GB heap, G1, one JVM per scenario

label: Scenarios
value: A reference shape; four sweeps that each change one thing of it: applications (5, 100, 500), instances (100 each), message types (1,000 each), and budget (256 MB); and the standalone deployment profile, the design target

label: Coverage
value: Every run ran the eight scenarios kept. Runs 1 to 6 also ran scenarios since dropped, as their points tracked the reference or a neighbour; those are no longer kept here. Runs 2 and 3 shared the machine with other work part of the time; the others had it idle

label: Before measuring
value: The whole history, filled at 5,000 spans/s as fast as the hub takes it, so scenarios that compare start from the same state

label: Each rate
value: Each rate of one ladder up to 300,000 spans/s offered for 30 s, open loop, until two fail in a row; the first 5 s of each are left out

label: Load
value: 4 generator threads; 8 submitting threads call admission and the intake queues

label: Exports
value: Every 5 s per instance, or as soon as it holds a full batch of 512 spans

label: Traces
value: Commands, queries, events across applications; 2% failed handlings; event-store delays 20 ms to 8 s

label: Not measured
value: OTLP/HTTP decoding and the network; queries; WebSocket sends to browsers
